title: Foolproof Hollandaise Sauce
summary: Egg yolks and soft butter whisked over gently simmering water with boiling water until thick and 71-74 °C, then brightened with lemon and cayenne.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Set up a bain-marie
steps.text: Bring 1 cm of water to a bare simmer in the saucepan. Rest the heatproof bowl on top so its base is clear of the water.

steps.title: Mix butter and yolks
steps.text: Whisk the softened butter and egg yolks together in the bowl until smooth and evenly mixed.

steps.title: Cook to temperature
steps.text: Slowly whisk in the boiling water. Keep whisking for 7-10 min until the sauce thickens and an instant-read thermometer shows 71-74 °C.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.text: Lift the bowl off the heat and whisk in the lemon juice, cayenne and salt. Spoon over steamed asparagus straight away.

tips: Keep the water at a bare simmer; fierce heat scrambles the yolks.
If it starts to look grainy, lift the bowl off the heat and whisk hard.
Hold warm over the turned-off pan for up to 30 min, whisking now and then.
Add a little more lemon juice to taste.
storage: Best served fresh. Do not reheat or keep leftovers. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
